title: A Spell Spoken to the Heart
title_ja: 心臓に語りかける呪文
description:
Spell 30B speaks directly to the heart. In an old translation, it begins, "My heart my mother." On this heart scarab, the museum identifies ten lines as Spell 30B.
Full episode: https://youtu.be/Xa0bcKAfgJI

Music: Suno.

description_ja:

title: Heart and Feather in Balance
title_ja: 心臓と羽根はつり合っていた
description:
People often say the heart had to be lighter than the feather. Here, the heart is not shown lighter. The two sides hang in balance.
Full episode: https://youtu.be/Xa0bcKAfgJI

#Shorts #History #AncientEgypt
description_ja:
心臓は羽根より軽くなければならなかった、とよく言われます。ここでは心臓は軽く描かれておらず、天秤の両側はつり合っています。

title: 42 Gods, 42 Denials: Could You Fail?
description:
In Spell 125, the dead person lists the wrongs they never did and greets forty-two gods by name. Could you fail?
Full episode: https://youtu.be/Xa0bcKAfgJI
